newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria 1996 trade deficit widens to 101.9 bln ats.
newsitem.headline: Austria 1996 trade deficit widens to 101.9 bln ats.

text.p: Austria's trade deficit widened 13.9 billion schillings, or 15.8 percent, to 101.9 billion schillings in 1996, state statistics office OeSTAT said on Wednesday.
A 107.8 billion schillings trade deficit with fellow European Union members was partly offset by a 5.9 billion schillings trade surplus with non-EU nations.
According to OeSTAT, imports rose by 37.9 billion schillings or 5.7 percent last year to 705.9 billion schillings. Exports increased by 24 billion schillings or 4.1 percent to 604 billion.
The statistics office said it expected to publish trade data for the first quarter of this year in July. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
